messages:
Lina (SRE): quick postmortem follow-up from today's cache-thundering incident. Need to lock owners for customer comms, confirm status page wording, decide who fields gated-RCA requests, and track the recurring-pattern action items.

Priya (Ops): I can own the public status copy + short 72h summary. aiming to have v1 by tomorrow noon.

Ethan (Product): For the public summary, keep it short and non-technical. Include clear impact numbers and 'what we're doing' bullets.

Ravi (Support): I'll collect the affected-tenant list and prepare outbound templates. Need final copy by tomorrow 3pm to hit the scheduled send.

Lina (SRE): Proposal for RCA sharing: public, short timeline on status page; detailed postmortem only via request for customers who need it (sales/enterprise). Ops to field requests and mark them in the postmortem tracker. This keeps sensitive internals private. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

Ethan (Product): agree. add a short FAQ entry: how to request detailed RCA + SLA for response (e.g., 5 business days).

Priya (Ops) (status copy draft v0):
```
On Mar 23, a cache eviction regression caused a transient increase in latency for a portion of text-generation requests between 02:10 and 02:40 UTC. Approximately 3-5% of requests experienced elevated latency.

We reverted the configuration change that caused the issue and deployed a patch to improve eviction handling. No customer data was exposed.

A brief timeline and next steps will be posted here. Customers requiring a detailed technical RCA can request it via support and we will respond within 5 business days.
```

Lina (SRE): Suggested public language tweaks: "transient increase in latency" -> "brief latency spike" and remove internal names. Also add: "We identified a related pattern in previous incidents and are running a systemic review."

Ravi (Support): for gated requests: Ops triages, then route to solutions/sales if customer asks for account-specific impact analysis. I will draft the request flow and response template.

Priya (Ops): Owners and deadlines (proposed):
- Public status page + 72h summary: Priya (Ops) - due: 1 business day
- Outbound customer messages for affected accounts: Ravi (Support) - due: tomorrow 3pm
- Fix + tests for eviction policy: Lina (SRE) - due: 10 business days (PR link when available)
- Systemic incident-pattern review (quarterly): Ethan (Product) + Lina (SRE) - schedule first review in 2 weeks

Ethan (Product): please add a task for product to evaluate fallback/default cache configs for Dedicated customers (they need explicit guidance). Owner: Ethan - due: 3 weeks.

Lina (SRE): I'll add unit + integration tests for eviction heuristics and a synthetic churn job in CI. Also enabling extra metrics for early detection.

postmortem-bot: Action items recorded: PM-2048, PM-2049. Link: https://internal.redwood/postmortems/PM-2048

Ravi (Support): sharing affected-tenant list now in a secure doc. Posting templates here for quick sign-off: "We experienced a brief latency spike on Mar 23 affecting a subset of requests. Our teams reverted the change and deployed a patch. We're proactively monitoring to ensure stability. No customer data exposure."

Priya (Ops): small edit to customer wording: include "what this means for you" with one line on whether customers need to take action (they don't).

Ethan (Product): +1. Adds reassurance.

Lina (SRE): I'll update the tracker with PRs and ETA once the fix branch is open. Will ping when the RCA draft (gated) is ready for review (roughly 7-10 days). Thanks everyone.
